description: Desktop console for a local OpenBao vault: secrets to processes, never to chat or logs.
notes: OpenBao 2.x is a prerequisite: install it, initialize it and unseal it.
edgePass talks only to a vault on loopback.
Requires the WebView2 Runtime (Windows 11 ships it; Windows 10 needs the Evergreen Runtime).
Quit edgePass before 'scoop update edgepass': Windows cannot replace a running .exe.
The binary is self-signed, so SmartScreen may warn about the publisher.
Config lives in %APPDATA%\edgePass; index, logs and placement live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\edgePass. Uninstalling does not delete either.
If you enabled start-at-logon, Ajustes has the button that removes it; the uninstaller also removes the task.
